name: 精神操作
desc: ①：以对方场上1只怪兽为对象才能发动。那只怪兽的控制权直到结束阶段得到。这个效果得到控制权的怪兽不能攻击宣言，不能解放。
faq: The effect of “Mind Control” that prevents the targeted monster from attacking or being Tributed lasts until the End Phase of the turn ”Mind Control” was activated, even if the monster is flipped face-down before the End Phase. If the monster targeted with this card is flipped face-down, it will still return to the original owner's side of the field during the End Phase.
ruling: The monster you take control of with "Mind Control" cannot be Tributed. You cannot Tribute it to summon a high-level monster. You cannot Tribute it with "Metamorphosis." You cannot Tribute it for "Enemy Controller." You cannot Tribute it with "Share the Pain." You cannot Tribute it with "Cannon Soldier." Curtis Schultz, 02/20/2005
